alei.title: Driveway Cleaning
alei.description: Effective removal of moss, algae, and stains from concrete and gravel driveways.
alei.details:
Our driveway cleaning service is the ideal solution for restoring the clean and welcoming appearance of your driveways. We use professional pressure washing equipment that effectively eliminates:

• Moss and algae that accumulate over time
• Oil stains and other substances
• Dust and deposited dirt
• Organic debris and plant residues

Our cleaning process respects the integrity of your surface, whether it's concrete, gravel, natural pavement, or other materials. Our team has experience in treating all types of driveways and entrances.

After cleaning, your driveway will be safe for pedestrian and vehicular traffic, eliminating the risk of slipping caused by moss or excessive humidity.

faq.q: How long does driveway cleaning take?
faq.a: The time required depends on the size of the driveway and the degree of dirt. In general, a medium-sized driveway (20-30 sqm) can be cleaned in 1-2 hours.

faq.q: Is it safe for nearby plants?
faq.a: Yes, we use techniques and products that do not affect plants and the surrounding environment. We can protect sensitive areas before starting the work.

faq.q: Does cleaning affect the driveway's waterproofing?
faq.a: No, our procedure maintains the integrity of the surface. If there are pre-existing waterproofing issues, we can recommend repairs before cleaning.

pereti.title: Exterior Wall Cleaning
pereti.description: Restoring the original appearance of exterior walls with professional washing equipment.
pereti.details:
Our exterior wall cleaning service brings back the original beauty of your building. Exterior walls are constantly exposed to the elements, accumulating:

• Dust and atmospheric pollution
• Mold stains and algae
• Water streaks and water stains
• Bird droppings
• Grease and residues from installations

Our team uses adjusted high-pressure equipment to clean effectively without damaging the walls' finish. We treat each type of surface (brick, concrete, wood, plaster) with specific techniques.

Regular cleaning of exterior walls not only improves aesthetics but also extends the life of finishes and prevents deterioration caused by accumulated dirt.

faq.q: Can brick walls be cleaned without affecting the joints?
faq.a: Yes, we adjust the pressure and cleaning techniques based on the material. For brick and sensitive joints, we use delicate but effective methods.
Absolutely. Cleaning walls before painting ensures optimal paint adhesion and a durable result. It's an essential step in surface preparation.

faq.q: Does cleaning work on wooden walls?
faq.a: Yes, we have experience cleaning exterior wooden walls. We use adjusted pressure and products compatible with wood to avoid damage.

terase.title: Deck Cleaning
terase.description: Clean and safe decks, perfect for immediate use after treatment.
terase.details:
A clean deck is a usable deck. Our deck cleaning service transforms your outdoor space into a perfect area for relaxation and socializing. We eliminate:

• Layers of dirt and dust
• Algae and moss that create slippery surfaces
• Food, drink, and grill stains
• Plant residues and pollen
• Deposits from rain and wind

Whether your deck is wood, ceramic, natural stone, or composite materials, we have the necessary expertise to clean it efficiently and safely.

After cleaning, the deck will be ready for immediate use. For wooden decks, we can also recommend applying protective products to extend the material's life.

faq.q: How long does cleaning a medium deck take?
faq.a: A deck of 20-30 sqm can be cleaned in 2-3 hours, depending on the degree of dirt and the type of material.

faq.q: Do I need to move furniture off the deck?
faq.a: We prefer that furniture be moved or covered. If you can't do this, our team can carefully move the furniture before starting the cleaning.

faq.q: Will wooden decks need retightening after cleaning?
faq.a: Cleaning doesn't affect the integrity of the wood. However, for decks constantly exposed to the sun, we recommend applying protective oil or lac periodically.

garduri.title: Fence Cleaning
garduri.description: Complete fence cleaning services to restore shine and aesthetic appearance.
garduri.details:
Your fence is the first visual impression of your property. Our fence cleaning service restores the beauty and integrity of fences. We efficiently clean:

• Dust deposits and pollution
• Moss and algae that affect appearance
• Old paint stains or other contaminants
• Plant residues and bird droppings
• Oxidation and discoloration

Our team has experience cleaning all types of fences: wood, metal, PVC, concrete, or combined materials. Each material requires a specific approach that we apply with professionalism.

A clean fence not only looks better but is also more durable. Removing harmful deposits prevents premature deterioration and reduces the need for costly repairs.

faq.q: Can old and deteriorated fences be cleaned?
faq.a: Yes, we can clean fences in any condition. However, for fences with significant damage, we recommend repairs before cleaning to avoid aggravating problems.

faq.q: Does cleaning affect existing paint on the fence?
faq.a: If the paint is in good condition, cleaning doesn't affect it. For areas with peeling paint, we recommend refreshing the finish after cleaning.

faq.q: Is cleaning necessary before painting the fence?
faq.a: It's absolutely necessary. Painting a dirty fence doesn't adhere correctly and results are short-lived. Cleaning is the first essential step in any repainting process.
